p: waters: The prophet shows the great compassion that he had toward this people, seeing that he could never sufficiently lament the destruction that he saw to hang over them, which is a special note to discern the true pastors from the hirelings. See Geneva "Jer 4:19"
lodging place of wayfaring men: He shows that there was more peace and greater safety for him to dwell among the wild beasts than among this wicked people except that God has given him this charge.
lies: To belie and slander their neighbours.
brother: Meaning, that all were corrupt, and none could find an honest man.
have taught their tongue to speak: They have so practised deceit, that they cannot forsake it.
through deceit they refuse to know: They would rather have forsaken God than left their wicked trade.
melt them: With the fire of affliction.
mountains will I take up a: Signifying that all the places about Jerusalem would be destroyed.
wise man: Meaning that they are all without sense and understanding and that God has taken his spirit from them.
their fathers taught them: He shows that the children cannot excuse themselves by their fathers: for both father and child if they are wicked will perish.

the skilful women: Seeing you cannot lament your own sins, call for those foolish women, whom of a superstition you have to lament for the dead, that they by their feigned tears may provoke you to some sorrow.
have cast us out: As though they were weary of us, because of our iniquities, Le 18:28,20:22.
teach your daughters wailing: He derides the superstition of the women who made an art of mourning, and taught to weep with feigned tears.
windows: Signifying that there is no means to deliver the wicked from God's judgments: but when they think to be most sure, and most far off, then they are soonest taken.

wise man glory in his wisdom: As none can save himself by his own labour, or any worldly means, he shows that it is vain to put our trust in it, but that we trust in the Lord, and rejoice in him, who only can deliver.

exercise lovingkindness: These three points are necessary to know correctly his mercy, in which consists our salvation: his judgment, which he executes continually against the wicked, and his justice, by which he defends and maintains the faithful.
circumcised with the uncircumcised: Meaning, both Jews and Gentiles, as in this next verse he shows the cause, Jer 4:4.
